```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Health is a top priority for all people, with no exceptions.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Economic relief should be provided directly to the people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Rescue efforts should prioritize workers and communities, not corporate executives.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A down payment should be made on a regenerative economy, while preventing future crises.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The democratic process and each other should be protected.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Joining the call for the People’s Bailout is an opportunity for DSA to provide an explicitly socialist voice in a coalition of multi-racial working-class organizations acting together to build momentum and unity around a COVID-19 solution for the working-class majority of this country, not the billionaires and ruling class.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[6]},{"claim_text":"This pandemic is a crisis of capitalism, a system so incredibly fragile that a few weeks of lost profit have sent it into a chaotic tailspin.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"Power must be built now to pave the road to a brighter future.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[8]},{"claim_text":"The Green Stimulus includes the expansion of public ownership in transit agencies, local housing authorities, public school districts, and electric co-ops and the creation of millions of new unionized green jobs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[8]},{"claim_text":"The Green Stimulus paints a clear picture of the world that is being fought for.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[8]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
